items.title: Al Rose Interview, 1975-02-03
items.q: when you start putting them together in duets with Emmanuel Sales

ctx.x: a jazz organization. You could listen to him as a solo I see.

That's right, exactly. And prefer to for that matter. Of course I've recorded Rayman a lot. I had that awful session with Jim Queskin, the jug band musician, a couple of years ago. I never had a chance to hear that for some reason. Well, you haven't missed anything, because this man just is not of the talent caliber to go with the kind of a band that we put together for him. And that was supposed to be released on Warner Brothers, but I doubt whether it was good enough. Not that the jazz men weren't, but…
What I'm getting at is you all have spent long hours of time together.
